entries.name: Chun-Li
entries.title: Ne pas ceder un pas
entries.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit this supplied Chun-Li Kalistar painting with only one costume correction. Replace the opaque dark blue trouser/legging fabric covering BOTH legs with her classic seamless thin BROWN/TAN PANTYHOSE TIGHTS, close-fitting fine hosiery with a subtle textile sheen, still covering the legs all the way into the white boots. No heavy trouser folds, no denim or thick fabric: these must read unmistakably as classic warm brown nylon tights, not bare legs. Keep her exact adult face, expression, raised side kick, coherent anatomy, hands, white boots, blue-gold qipao and its tails, cuffs, hair, ribbons, original framing, painted style, lighting and quiet background unchanged. Do not sexualize or change camera framing. No other edits, no text, no frame.

entries.name: Guile
entries.title: L'ouverture du Sonic Boom
entries.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Revise the supplied Guile Kalistar painting: change ONLY his arm action into the final OPEN-ARM follow-through of a Sonic Boom. His arms are now spread APART on either side of his torso, elbows slightly bent outward, fists separated near shoulder level, chest unobstructed, not crossed, not touching each other. Show both shoulders, upper arms, elbows, forearms and hands coherently. A pale restrained air crescent travels away from him. Keep his exact adult face and flat-top blond hair, serious combat focus, olive shirt, dog tags, camo trousers, boots, grounded legs and background, same painted grain and lighting. If required zoom out slightly to retain both hands inside the vertical frame; no huge arms or extra limbs. No other new objects, no text, no UI.

entries.name: Vega
entries.title: La garde du predateur
entries.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. One standalone vertical 4:5 illustration for the Kalistar Street Fighter fan-art selection, no card frame, text, logo, watermark or interface. PREMIUM NARRATIVE FANTASY DIGITAL PAINTING matching Kalistar's worn painted materials: visible confident brushwork, sculpted colour planes, selective crisp edges on expression and gesture, tactile cloth/leather/metal, motivated cinematic light. No photograph or photorealism, no smooth 3D, no anime/manga face or flat comics. Recognizable Street Fighter character identity, not generic medieval armour. Adult character with believable anatomy, two arms and two legs, coherent hands and weight, no enormous perspective fist or foot. One specific emotional instant in combat, not a fashion pose. Essential face and gesture central with margin for a future737x921 artwork window. Background VERY RESTRAINED: broad low-contrast painted masses with only ONE setting cue, no crowd, no city skyline, no fine rubble field or ornate clutter, no particle storm. Painted simplification, not photographic blur. Illustration alone, no blood or gore. Vega, the adult Spanish masked claw fighter from Street Fighter, long blond-brown braided hair, slim athletic build, white smooth mask with narrow eye openings, bare torso and recognizable serpent tattoo, high-waisted purple and white matador-like combat trousers with burgundy sash. NEW COMPOSITION: full-figure upright high fighting guard, both ARMS RAISED UP beside/above his head in his elegant characteristic guard. One forearm with THREE STRAIGHT PARALLEL METAL CLAWS points upward diagonally, claws clearly fixed to a glove/bracer on the hand; the other arm is raised with its open hand above shoulder height. Mask angled toward an off-screen adversary, arrogant concentration visible in eyes. Weight on rear leg, front knee lightly bent, poised to spring; not a horizontal fencing lunge. Behind him, his COMBAT CAGE: one broad aged steel mesh panel and one corner upright, subdued and low contrast; no audience or surrounding architecture. Warm muted arena top light, cool grey shadows, all essentials inside frame. Refined menace, visible painterly textures, straight coherent weapon.
